title: Dirt & Diamonds
description: This project adds a new block in Minecraft called "Dirtmond" that has the texture of diamonds in a dirt block!
body:
This mod adds a new block, "Dirtmond" This is a mix of diamonds on a dirt texture. You can only mine it with a iron/diamond/netherite pickaxe/shovel, as it drops diamonds, so it ensures fairness (can spawn in the overworld, not too hard to find) I hope you enjoy and please, if you use this for content, add my YouTube channel please. Also a subscribe would be much appreciated!: https://www.youtube.com/@MrInvisiblexYT. It would be much appreciated. 

All the best,

MrInvisibleYT.
